options.name: action_url
options.description: URL for actions for the host (for example, an external graphing tool).

options.name: address
options.description: The host's IPv4 address. Available as command runtime macro $address$ if set.

options.name: address6
options.description: The host's IPv6 address. Available as command runtime macro $address6$ if set.

options.name: check_command
options.description: The name of the check command.

options.name: check_interval
options.description: The check interval (in seconds). This interval is used for checks when the host is in a HARD state. Defaults to 5m.

options.name: check_period
options.description: The name of a time period which determines when this host should be checked. Not set by default (effectively 24x7).

options.name: check_timeout
options.description: Check command timeout in seconds. Overrides the CheckCommand's timeout attribute."

options.name: command_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint where commands are executed on.

options.name: display_name
options.description: A short description of the host (e.g. displayed by external interfaces instead of the name if set).

options.name: enable_active_checks
options.description: Whether active checks are enabled. Defaults to true.

options.name: enable_event_handler
options.description: Enables event handlers for this host. Defaults to true.

options.name: enable_flapping
options.description: Whether flap detection is enabled. Defaults to false.

options.name: enable_notifications
options.description: Whether notifications are enabled. Defaults to true.

options.name: enable_passive_checks
options.description: Whether passive checks are enabled. Defaults to true.

options.name: enable_perfdata
options.description: Whether performance data processing is enabled. Defaults to true.

options.name: event_command
options.description: The name of an event command that should be executed every time the host's state changes or the host is in a SOFT state.

options.name: file
options.description: Path to the file in which the object will be defined.

options.name: flapping_threshold_high
options.description: Flapping upper bound in percent for a host to be considered flapping. Default 30.0

options.name: flapping_threshold_low
options.description: Flapping lower bound in percent for a host to be considered  not flapping. Default 25.0

options.name: groups
options.description: A list of host groups this host belongs to.

options.name: icon_image
options.description: Icon image for the host. Used by external interfaces only.

options.name: icon_image_alt
options.description: Icon image description for the host. Used by external interface only.

options.name: imports
options.description: List of imports for the Host.

options.name: max_check_attempts
options.description: The number of times a host is re-checked before changing into a hard state. Defaults to 3.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Host object.

options.name: notes
options.description: Notes for the host.

options.name: notes_url
options.description: URL for notes for the host (for example, in notification commands).

options.name: order
options.description: Value to determine internal precedence.

options.name: retry_interval
options.description: The retry interval (in seconds). This interval is used for checks when the host is in a SOFT state. Defaults to 1m. Note: This does not affect the scheduling after a passive check result.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the Host object.

options.name: template
options.description: Whether the Host is a template.

options.name: vars
options.description: A dictionary containing custom variables that are specific to this host.

options.name: volatile
options.description: Treat all state changes as HARD changes. See here for details. Defaults to false.

options.name: zone
options.description: The zone this object is a member of. Please read the distributed monitoring chapter for details.
